capabilities: match notes into rule scopes by file, folder, tag, filename, or property conditions
check required frontmatter properties and their values with equals, contains, and regex operators
check required headings and heading order
check filename patterns and direct child folder structures, including vault root whitelists
run checks from a ribbon button or the command line with failure exit codes and JSON output
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It documents CLI exit codes (0 pass, 1 failure, 2 checker error) and manual installation steps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to enforce note structure rules (required properties, headings, filename patterns, folder layout) or to run those checks outside the app so agents can fix failures.
summary: Rule-based checker that validates notes against scoped rules covering properties, headings, filename patterns, and folder structures, with a CLI for AI agents.
